slides.eyebrow: LIFE LESSONS FOR A BETTER YOU
slides.body: Har break weakness nahi hota. Rest tumhe better pace par wapas laata hai.
Har din 100% output expect karna sustainable nahi hota.
Sleep, pause aur quiet time tumhari energy ko rebuild karte hain.
Break lene se goal chhota nahi hota; tum use long-term bana rahe ho.
Aaj ek task remove karo, screen break lo aur time par so jao.
Tumhe har din prove nahi karna. Tumhe consistent rehna hai.

caption:
Rest lena progress ko rokna nahi hai.

Aaj apni energy ko respect karo, pause lo aur kal better pace par continue karo.
